Home / Solicitations / SOL-2026-041

Seasonal dock maintenance and piling inspection

SOL-2026-041 · Invitation to bid · Harbor and Marine Services

Summary

Closing dateAug 21, 2026, 2 p.m. Central
Issuing departmentHarbor and Marine Services
ContactDana Wexley, contract officer, bids@lakefront-vn.example
ResponsesRegistered partners only, through the partner console

Scope of work

Annual inspection of 214 timber and steel pilings at the municipal marina and the Canal Row wharf, with repair of decking, cleats and fender boards found defective. Work is scheduled between October 1 and December 15, outside the boating season.

  • Two-year term with one optional renewal year.
  • Bid bond of 5% of the bid price.
  • Diver certification required for any crew working below the waterline.

Addenda

  • Addendum 1 (Jul 30, 2026): piling survey drawings reissued at a larger scale.

Questions about this solicitation go to the contact above in writing, no later than seven days before the closing date. Answers are published here as addenda.
